items.en_title: Vargem Grande do Rio Pardo (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #0005
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Vargem Grande do Rio Pardo (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 3,216,058.37; proposals close Dec 1, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
